supported_placeholders.label: User Full Name
supported_placeholders.description: The full name of the user receiving the email.
supported_placeholders.usage: Use in greeting or salutation, e.g. Hello {{UserName}},

supported_placeholders.label: Username
supported_placeholders.description: The unique username / login ID assigned to the user account.
supported_placeholders.usage: Use in credentials section, e.g. Username: {{Username}}

supported_placeholders.label: Temporary Password
supported_placeholders.description: The system-generated temporary password for initial user login.
supported_placeholders.usage: Use in credentials section, e.g. Password: {{TemporaryPassword}}

supported_placeholders.label: Company / Application Name
supported_placeholders.description: The configured organization or application brand name from APP_NAME.
supported_placeholders.usage: Use in headers or signatures, e.g. Welcome to {{CompanyName}}

supported_placeholders.label: Support Email
supported_placeholders.description: The official support contact email address configured in the system.
supported_placeholders.usage: Use in support/footer links, e.g. Contact us at {{SupportEmail}}

templates.name: New User Account Created
templates.description: Triggered when an administrator creates a new user account or resends login credentials.
templates.sample_html_body:
{{CompanyName}}

Hello {{UserName}},

Your account has been created. Here are your credentials:

Username:{{Username}}
Password:{{TemporaryPassword}}

Please change your password after logging in. For queries, contact {{SupportEmail}}.
